issue_title: Math.roman produces wrong numerals for some inputs
issue_body: This build adds a helper Math.roman(n: number): string that converts a whole number into a classical Roman numeral using standard subtractive notation: 1=I, 4=IV, 5=V, 9=IX, 10=X, 40=XL, 50=L, 90=XC, 100=C, 400=CD, 500=D, 900=CM, 1000=M. Most values look right, but some come out wrong: Math.roman(9) returns "VIIII" instead of "IX", and Math.roman(90) returns "LXXXX" instead of "XC". Please find and fix the conversion so it produces correct numerals.

expected_behavior: Math.roman renders integers as correct classical Roman numerals.
The output follows standard conversion rules.
